_comment: SPONSORS PAGE COPY (English). REAL CONTENT (2026), partially: the board-approved resolution for 'Taqathon 2' (board minutes dated 2026-07-21) names exactly two confirmed 2026 partners — University of Jeddah as the scientific/academic partner, and Mishkat Interactive Center (مركز مشكاة التفاعلي) for judging support — and authorizes the executive team to sign with them and activate outreach to other supporting entities. Beyond those two, no specific sponsor names or tiers (Platinum/Gold/Silver) are confirmed for 2026 — 2025's sponsor list (Johnson Controls-York, Association Support Fund, etc., from the association's 2025 presentation deck) is NOT reused here since none of those are confirmed to be returning; inventing tier placeholders again would misrepresent partners who haven't actually signed on. See PROGRESS.md's 'still missing' list.

hero.heading: Sponsors & Partners
hero.intro: The Association's board has confirmed two partners for Taqathon 2 so far. Sponsorship tiers for 2026 are still being finalized.
